lines.text: Meta just rebuilt Andromeda.
And most advertisers missed it.
On October 28th, Meta released the next generation of Andromeda.
Same job, deciding which ad each person sees, with a brand new brain.
Meta says it can check over a billion ads a second.
Quick recap.
People are the fish,
your ads are the bait,
and Andromeda is the current that carries each bait to the right fish.
Here's what changed.
The old Andromeda was one current that read every fish the same way.
The new one is a team of specialists.
One tracks what each fish has been biting lately.
One knows which school it swims with.
One understands what your bait actually means.
And one follows the fish across Facebook and Instagram.
Together they tell the fish apart far better than before.
Meta says Facebook conversions are up 2.4% since 2025.
But ten copies of the same worm still end up at the same school.
That's why your creative diversity rating matters.
Low, medium or high, it's your fish finder.
That's where Adwave comes in.
We make creative across different angles,
for different ideal customers,
at every awareness level,
and in every format.
In lake terms, the right bait for every fish, at every depth.
Then we measure what's biting, and we iterate.
Cut what isn't working, and double down on what is.
Check your rating today.
If it says low, Adwave builds the tackle box.
